name: Bento

portrait.alt: Bento, a brown dachshund with a teal collar, sitting in the studio

bio: Our resident dachshund. Welcomes visitors, joins the team for walks and finds the warmest spot in the studio. He has attended every team meeting since 2019, usually asleep, and he is the first to greet clients at the door. Bento does not take on consulting work, but he is very good at making difficult meetings feel calmer.
